_note: A workman's compensation on retrenchment: deducted up to the least of what was received, the amount the retrenchment statute entitles, and the notified limit (D-109; rulebook RET-RETRENCH-001). Compensation under an approved scheme is RET-RETRENCHMENT-APPROVED-SCHEME. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 10 (p.43), "Minimum of — (a) compensation received; (b) amount calculated as per provisions of section 25F(b) of the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 (14 of 1947); (c) such amount, not being less than ₹50000, as may be notified by the Central Government."; s.19(2)(c)–(d) (p.45): closure and certain transfers are retrenchment, and "employer" and "workman" take the Industrial Disputes Act's meanings. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10B) (thc.nic.in p.73), the first proviso: "(i) an amount calculated in accordance with the provisions of clause (b) of section 25F of the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 (14 of 1947); or (ii) such amount, not being less than fifty thousand rupees, as the Central Government may, by notification … specify … whichever is less". The Industrial Disputes Act stood repealed from 21-11-2025 (S.O. 465(E)); s.25F(b) is read as the Industrial Relations Code, 2020 s.70(b) for a retrenchment on or after that day (D-107) — "fifteen days' average pay, or average pay of such days as may be notified by the appropriate Government". The amount is the employer's figure under the Act in force on the separation day (StatutoryEntitlement). The notified limit, Rs 5,00,000 (Notification No. 10969, 25-6-1999), is read in the Department of Revenue's consolidation (footnote 66 to s.10(10B): retrenchment on or after 1-1-1997) and in footnote 28 of the Department's s.10 page ("on or after 1-1-1977"; D-182); s.536(2)(j) of the 2025 Act carries it into TY 2026-27. Every regime.
